hero.greeting: Śrī Gaṇeśāya Namaḥ • శ్రీ గణేశాయ నమః
hero.name: Karthikeya Pidaparthy
hero.description: A young scholar of Sanskrit, Telugu & English — memoriser of 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gītā, laureate of the Sanskrit Olympiad, and devoted pārāyaṇa seeker in the grand tradition of Sanātana Dharma.

about.para1: Born into a family that cherishes the Vedic tradition, Karthikeya has shown an extraordinary gift for scripture, language, and devotion since his early childhood. At just 10 years of age, he stands as a shining testament to the living power of Sanātana Dharma.
about.para2: Residing in Sydney, Australia, he balances academic excellence with deep spiritual practice — performing regular pārāyaṇa at local temples, competing in Sanskrit Olympiads, and reciting works from the great masters of Telugu and Sanskrit literature.
about.card_lang_body: Fluent in Telugu, English, and deeply proficient in Sanskrit. Reads Devanāgarī, Telugu, and Roman IAST scripts with ease.
about.card_scripture_body: Has listened to complete Rāmāyaṇa and Mahābhārata pravachanams by Chaganti Koteswara Rao. Familiar with stories from the Bhāgavata, Upaniṣads, and Itihāsas.
about.card_community_body: Performs Viṣṇu Sahasranāma and Lalitā Sahasranāma pārāyaṇa at Sydney Murugan Temple and participates in cultural programmes across Sydney's Indian community.

achievements.title: Gold Medal — Bhagavad Gītā
achievements.desc: Awarded the Gold Medal by the prestigious Mysore Datta Peetham for memorising and reciting all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gītā.

achievements.title: Bhagavad Gītā — Helensburgh Temple
achievements.desc: Chanted the complete Śrīmad Bhagavad Gītā at Helensburgh Temple on the occasion of Paṇḍit Rishikesh Bhattar's Ṣaṣṭipūrti Mahōtsavam — a rare and sacred offering.

achievements.title: Sanskrit Olympiad — 1st in Australia
achievements.desc: Secured 1st place in Australia and All India Rank 266 in the previous year in the Sanskrit Olympiad conducted by Central Sanskrit University, New Delhi — for two consecutive years.
achievements.year: Central Sanskrit University, India · 2 consecutive years

achievements.title: Soundaryalaharī Pārāyaṇa
achievements.desc: Memorised all 100 verses of Śaṅkarācārya's Soundaryalaharī and performed pārāyaṇa at Sydney Ayyappa Temple during Navarātri.

achievements.title: Śivapadam Recitation
achievements.desc: Recited 10 Śivapadam poems composed by Samavedam Shanmukha Sharma in his presence and received a special memento from the great scholar when he visited Sydney.

achievements.title: Saṅkaṭanāśana Ganeśa Stotram
achievements.desc: Personally offered a handwritten copy of the Saṅkaṭanāśana Ganeśa Stotram to Vaddiparti Padmakar, Samavedam Shanmukha Sharma, and Madugula Naga Phani Sharma.

achievements.title: Viṣṇu & Lalitā Sahasranāma
achievements.desc: Performs regular Viṣṇu Sahasranāma and Lalitā Sahasranāma pārāyaṇa at Sydney Murugan Temple, contributing to the spiritual life of the community.

achievements.title: 'Para Bhāṣa Lekundā Telugu Lo' — Winner
achievements.desc: Won first place in the competition 'Para Bhāṣa Lekundā Telugu Lo' at around age 3–4, demonstrating exceptional Telugu language ability at an incredibly young age.

achievements.title: Mānava Kathā & Gajendra Mokṣam Competitions
achievements.desc: Won prizes in Mānava Kathā and Gajendra Mokṣam competitions organised by Pranava Peetham (Vaddiparti Padmakar).

achievements.title: Cultural Competition Prizes
achievements.desc: Won multiple prizes in Rāmāyaṇa and Daśāvatāra competitions organised by Sydney Jana Ranjani, and poetry competitions by Pranava Peetham.

achievements.title: Avadānam — Aprastuta Prasaṅga
achievements.desc: Participated as the Aprastuta Prasaṅga Pṛcchakudu (questioner) in the avadānam performed by the renowned Taṭavarti Kalyāṇ.

achievements.title: Bhāratam Laghu Prasaṅgālu
achievements.desc: Delivered a series of short discourses on the Mahābhārata published on YouTube, demonstrating depth of understanding of the great Itihāsa.

parayana.intro: Karthikeya regularly performs these sacred pārāyaṇas. Each Sanskrit verse appears in three scripts — select your preferred script using the tabs.

stotras.title: Bhagavad Gītā · 700 Verses
stotras.te:
యదా యదా హి ధర్మస్య గ్లానిర్భవతి భారత ।
అభ్యుత్థానమధర్మస్య తదాత్మానం సృజామ్యహమ్ ॥
stotras.dev:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
stotras.iast:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata |
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmy aham ||
stotras.attribution: Bhagavad Gītā 4.7 — "Whenever there is decline of righteousness, I manifest myself."

stotras.title: Viṣṇu Sahasranāma
stotras.te:
విశ్వం విష్ణుర్వషట్కారో భూతభవ్యభవత్ప్రభుః ।
భూతకృద్భూతభృద్భావో భూతాత్మా భూతభావనః ॥
stotras.dev:
विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कारो भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः ।
भूतकृद्भूतभृद्भावो भूतात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
stotras.iast:
viśvaṁ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāro bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ |
bhūtakṛd bhūtabhṛd bhāvo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||
stotras.attribution: Opening śloka — performed at Sydney Murugan Temple

stotras.title: Lalitā Sahasranāma
stotras.attribution: Opening nāmas — performed at Sydney Murugan Temple

stotras.title: Soundaryalaharī · 100 Verses
stotras.te:
శివః శక్త్యా యుక్తో యది భవతి శక్తః ప్రభవితుం
న చేదేవం దేవో న ఖలు కుశలః స్పందితుమపి ।
stotras.dev:
शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं
न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि ।
stotras.iast:
śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṁ
na cedevaṁ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditum api |
stotras.attribution: Opening verse by Ādi Śaṅkarācārya — Navarātri, Ayyappa Temple

stotras.title: Saṅkaṭanāśana Ganeśa Stotram
stotras.te:
ప్రణమ్య శిరసా దేవం గౌరీపుత్రం వినాయకమ్ ।
భక్తావాసం స్మరేన్నిత్యమాయుఃకామార్థసిద్ధయే ॥
stotras.dev:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं गौरीपुत्रं विनायकम् ।
भक्तावासं स्मरेन्नित्यमायुःकामार्थसिद्धये ॥
stotras.iast:
praṇamya śirasā devaṁ gaurīputraṁ vināyakam |
bhaktāvāsaṁ smaren nityam āyuḥkāmārthasiddhaye ||
stotras.attribution: Offered in person to Vaddiparti Padmakar, Samavedam Shanmukha Sharma & Madugula Naga Phani Sharma

list.text: It is heartening to see the next generation embracing Sanskrit with such commitment. His performance in the Olympiad reflects both natural talent and disciplined practice.
During Navarātri, Karthikeya's pārāyaṇa of Soundaryalaharī filled the temple with a sacred vibration. Such dedication from a 10-year-old is truly divine grace.
